definitions: Cyberattacks that exploit a vulnerability in software or hardware that is unknown to the vendor or public, meaning there is no patch or fix available at the time of the attack.
Attacks that occur on the same day a vulnerability becomes known, before a fix can be developed and distributed.
examples: Security experts are constantly on the lookout for Zero-day attacks.
The company fell victim to a sophisticated Zero-day attack.
Protecting against Zero-day attacks requires advanced threat detection.
